title: This Land Crab Pinches Harder Than Almost Any Animal Bites
subject: coconut crab

scenes.text: A crab on land pinches harder than almost any land animal bites.
It's the coconut crab. Up to nine pounds, the biggest land crustacean on Earth.
Scientists measured 29 wild crabs on Okinawa. The strongest grip hit about 1,765 newtons. A human bite tops out near 1,300.
For the biggest crabs, they calculated 3,300 newtons. Only an alligator bites harder on land.
That's how it cracks open coconuts. It can even lift about 62 pounds.
So that crab? Its biggest claw outguns your bite more than two to one.

description:
The coconut crab has the strongest pinch of any crustacean.
Measured grips reached about 1,765 newtons, and the largest crabs are estimated at 3,300 newtons, more than any land animal's bite except an alligator's.
Would you let it shake your hand?
first_comment: Which would you rather face: a coconut crab or an alligator?
